reviewNotes: HOLD. Mint Mobile remains a current T-Mobile-network prepaid subscription with a durable 12-month 6GB plan at USD180/year and a provider-defined 60-day suspended-account window after plan expiry before cancellation/reassignment may occur. Current official material supports same-day eSIM delivery and free Wi-Fi Calling abroad, but does not establish a reliable China-first activation/payment path or standalone China cellular incoming-SMS/OTP behavior. A fresh community thread remains contradictory on overseas activation and describes US-address/VPN workarounds, so those are not promoted as a supported acquisition path.

events.outcome: Current Mint terms establish suspension at plan expiry and cancellation/reassignment risk after 60 days without successful renewal while suspended. The 12-month 6GB plan remains USD180/year. Official Wi-Fi Calling is usable abroad, while reliable China-first activation/payment and standalone China cellular SMS/OTP remain unresolved.

data.acquisitionSummary: Mint Mobile currently sells prepaid service on the T-Mobile network with same-day eSIM delivery or a shipped physical SIM. The durable 12-month 6GB plan is USD15/month paid as USD180 upfront; temporary new-customer promotions are not treated as the long-term retention baseline.

keep.action: Renew the 12-month 6GB plan before expiry. Current Mint terms put an expired unpaid account into suspended status; after 60 days without a successful renewal the account may be cancelled and the number reassigned. Treat the 60-day period as recovery only, not as the maintenance interval.

data.chinaActivation: Official pages support digital eSIM delivery but do not establish a China-first activation path. A September 2026 community thread is contradictory and describes VPN plus U.S.-address/payment workarounds; these are not treated as a supported route.
data.kyc: Mint is prepaid and current plan material does not advertise a credit check. Exact foreign-subscriber identity requirements are not established by the reviewed official pages.
data.payment: Current terms support renewal payments and account auto-renewal. Reliable foreign-issued-card acceptance is not established by the reviewed official material; current community workarounds often depend on a U.S. billing address.
data.wifiCalling: Mint officially provides free Wi-Fi Calling on all plans; calls and texts over Wi-Fi do not consume a Minternational Pass.
data.roamingSms: Mint supports international roaming through Minternational Pass and Wi-Fi Calling. A current standalone pay-per-use China incoming-SMS rule and third-party OTP reliability were not established in this review.
data.holdReason: Reliable China-first activation/payment and standalone China cellular incoming-SMS/OTP behavior remain unresolved; fresh community evidence is contradictory and depends on unsupported VPN/U.S.-billing workarounds.
data.tariffSummary: 12-month 6GB plan: USD180/year. Expired unpaid service enters suspension; 60 days without renewal can lead to cancellation/number reassignment. Wi-Fi Calling works abroad.
guideSteps: Use a normal supported U.S. acquisition/activation path rather than assuming VPN-based overseas activation.
Renew before the annual plan expiry; treat the 60-day suspended period as recovery only.
Enable and verify Wi-Fi Calling before relying on the line abroad, and do not claim China cellular OTP without route-specific evidence.
